rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for language that sounds natural and native rather than translated.

example.english: This English sentence sounds very idiomatic.
example.jyutping: ne1 geoi3 jing1 man2 gong2 dak1 hou2 dei6 dou6

rows.note: Use this for code or another technical practice that follows the language's usual conventions.

example.english: This code is idiomatic, so everyone can understand it at a glance.
example.traditional: 呢段程式碼寫法符合慣例，其他人一睇就明。
example.jyutping: ni1 dyun6 cing4 sik1 maa5 se2 faat3 fu4 hap6 gwaan3 lai6 kei4 taa1 jan4 jat1 tai2 zau6 ming4

rows.note: Use this for speech or writing that contains many idioms.

example.english: Their speech is idiomatic, so I often have to guess what they mean.
example.traditional: 佢講嘢充滿慣用語，成日要我估佢想講乜。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gong2 je5 cung1 mun5 gwaan3 jung6 jyu5 seng4 jat6 jiu3 ngo5 gu2 keoi5 soeng2 gong2 mat1
